rules.DIRECTLY MEASURED: Exact complete source/frame/observation/descriptor tuple in named recording; provenance and waveform retrieved
rules.INTERPOLATION-SUPPORTED: Only passing E1 stratum; same recording and all other descriptors fixed; source-tested axis value; strict two-neighbor bracket; duration ratio <=4, offset gap <=2; no joint interpolation
rules.WEAKLY SUPPORTED: Conditional passing E2 template only on explicit class_template request; not individual prediction. Failed/underpowered/new continuous query returns UNKNOWN
rules.OUT OF DISTRIBUTION / UNKNOWN: Missing tuple/family/frame/preparation/observation, requested fly/root/subtype/column, unsupported horizon, absent bracket, or invented input field returns no waveform

uncertainty: UNCERTAINTY.json; null means unbounded/unidentified, never zero
